'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 James Barnes DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
